requirement_text.REQ-430: MOB-8 in docs/mobile/requirements.md: v1 is online-first with a read-through definition cache; offline writes, push-based cache invalidation and an on-device form builder are out of v1 and recorded as deferred (architecture.md §4). Its own text calls it "a gate": an offline cache grows a write queue one reasonable commit at a time. BUILDS: 1. A static guard in apps/mobile/test/guards/ that fails if pubspec.yaml gains a push/messaging dependency (firebase_messaging or equivalent), a background-task/workmanager package, or if any file under apps/mobile/lib persists an outgoing request (a store write whose payload is a request body/method/url), with self-tests. 2. Reconcile docs/mobile/architecture.md §4's scope table with the shipped feature set, listing each MOB requirement's delivering REQ id, and marking the three exclusions as deferred. 3. Record in docs/migration/stage-9-mobile.md which build-order phase gates (build-order.md "Phasing": M-1 two tenants + secure tokens; M-2 airplane-mode + pinned versions never substitute; M-3 all six states incl. forced 429) are demonstrated and by which tests, and which parts are DEFERRED (iOS build and runtime checks -- Windows host; interactive login -- UAT-RUNNER) with reasons. Stage REVIEWER sign-off and status flips stay with REVIEWER and DOC-UPDATER.

result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/req430-mobile-scope-boundary.md. §1 designs apps/mobile/test/guards/v1_scope_boundary_guard_test.dart: Checker A (checkV1ScopeDependencies) scans pubspec.yaml/pubspec.lock dependency names via the existing extraction helpers against an exact+substring forbidden list (firebase_messaging, onesignal_flutter, flutter_fcm, workmanager, android_alarm_manager_plus, background_fetch, flutter_background_service, plus substrings), with explicit reasoning for exclusions (firebase_core, flutter_local_notifications, connectivity_plus are NOT forbidden). Checker B (checkNoPersistedOutgoingRequests) is a regex-based heuristic: find `.record(...).put(` call-sites, scan a bounded window (smallest enclosing block or fixed char window -- left as OQ-2) for 2-or-more of the key tokens method/url/body/request as quoted-map-keys or named-args, flag OutgoingRequestPersistenceViolation; documented false-negative boundaries (renamed fields, cross-statement assembly) and false-positive boundary (a legitimately-named definition field), verified against both real sembast repositories' actual stored shapes (neither uses these key names). Four self-test fixtures specified per AC1 (firebase_messaging pubspec, workmanager pubspec, method/url/body map literal, real tree). §2 gives the exact replacement markdown for architecture.md §4 with a scope table mapping all 8 MOB-N rows to their delivering REQ ids (cross-checked against docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-417..430 entries) plus the three deferred exclusions, each now tied to which guard checker enforces it. §3 gives the exact new stage-9-mobile.md section citing real test files from the actual `find apps/mobile/test -type f` listing run this session (auth/bootstrap tests for M-1, definitions/pinned-form/task-pinned-version tests for M-2, renderer-state/backpressure/claim-conflict/the new guard itself for M-3) and both deferred items with reasons (Windows host has no iOS toolchain; interactive OIDC login needs UAT-RUNNER). §4 lists 4 open questions (OQ-1 helper code-sharing mechanism, OQ-2 window-computation choice, OQ-3 forbidden-list non-exhaustiveness, OQ-4 no collision with current deps -- informational). Verified during design: `git grep -n -i -E 'outbox|pending_writes|write_queue|offline_queue' -- apps/mobile` returns zero hits today (exit 1), consistent with AC2 and with no write-queue code existing yet. No implementation code (.dart bodies) written anywhere in the design doc -- only fixture source snippets shown as illustrative string content for self-test fixtures, and the architecture.md/stage-9-mobile.md markdown is doc-edit content, not application code, per this agent's own instructions.
